title: You need to pay
body: Sent them an email for a refund because i paid $38.90 per year on accident thinking there was a trial, it was honestly my bad it would be grateful to get a response though. The app wasn’t good, there are better AIs out there that did better. The entire experience was like having a conversation with an inexperienced underdeveloped cheap AI. I do not recommend. I gave them the benefit of the doubt wanting to try ard the app but damn it was horrible, laggy and dumb.
author: AnHonestReviewer(:

title: All content behind paywall
body:
Saw it on TikTok and downloaded with enthusiasm

Until I realised, you cannot see any of the features or what it’s gonna do for you, what the interface looks like, or any of these things without paying first. Would be useful at least to have one day free trial to see what it looks like.
author: Shquishy
